figures.classification: Black-and-white instructional apparatus schematic, not a natural photograph.

groups.facts: One approximately circular annular machine surrounds an empty center. Four thick curved magnet sectors occupy upper-right, upper-left, lower-left and lower-right quadrants. Each has an inner and an outer curved boundary with short end edges. Gaps occur at the top, left, bottom and right. There is no second independent ring or instructional grid.

A broken/dashed line follows each curved magnet sector between its boundaries. Four short solid straight portions occupy the cardinal gaps and join the curved portions into one closed circulation route. Top and bottom portions meet rectangular apparatus. No named point, numerical coordinate, tick, angle, dimension, unit or discernible circulation arrowhead is present.

An outlined roughly rectangular component with short connectors straddles the upper gap; the acceleration callout points inside it. A second outlined roughly rectangular component with connectors straddles the bottom gap but has no separate source label. The left and right gaps show short straight vertical apparatus/channel portions. The source does not state a dimension or independently name the bottom component.

A horizontal tube enters from the left, above the middle of the left straight portion. It contains two visible outlined inline box/coupling shapes. The tube bends right and downward into the left ring gap. The source label above the incoming tube reads 引入口. No source arrowhead or numerical specification is visible.

A short double-line branch leaves the lower end of the right straight portion and extends diagonally upward and outward to the right. The vertical source callout on the right reads 粒子束引出口. There is no readable numerical specification or clearly resolved arrowhead.

Four Chinese apparatus labels are visible: 加速装置 above the ring with a diagonal leader to the upper box; 磁铁 below-left with a leader to the lower-left curved sector; 引入口 above the inlet; 粒子束引出口 vertically to the right of the outgoing branch. Labels identify apparatus rather than measured data.

figures.noninstructional_marks: Small isolated black glyph/speck residues occur below the diagram near the bottom of the crop. They are recorded as scan/caption residue, not apparatus, a point label or a given value, and will not be reproduced.

historical_identity.from_authoritative_text: An illustrative ring accelerator for n100, described by the modern bilingual author as a proton synchrotron. This schematic is not itself evidence that it is an exact plan of the Dubna or Serpukhov facility.

figures.classification: Wide high-contrast binary reproduction of a natural interior photograph; not an exact apparatus schematic or countable geometrical lattice.

groups.facts: A large foreground ring of industrial equipment curves across the lower image and recedes toward the left and right. Repeated bulky curved or ribbed housings form the visible near and right-hand sectors. Supporting frames, side surfaces, fittings and dark spaces appear beneath and between equipment. Occlusion and binary texture prevent a reliable total magnet or component count.

A tall, bulky central structure rises in the middle background, with broad horizontal bands, many pale rectangular face panels and dark openings or support regions beneath. Equipment continues behind or around it. It is not a labelled central point or a stated measured cylinder.

An oblique stair or access structure with railings crosses the left foreground toward the central/ring equipment. Additional platforms, railings, narrow structural members and equipment are visible around the left side. No unambiguous human figure or exact number of steps can be resolved from the source.

The machine stands inside an extensive industrial hall. Curving/receding ceiling ribs, beams or pipes occupy the upper image, with structural supports, dark wall regions and repeated pale rectangular window/panel-like regions across the rear and right background. These repeated natural forms are not an instructional grid with specified rows, columns, offsets or equal gaps.

One panoramic view uses oblique elevated perspective, with high-contrast black-and-white photographic texture and an irregular light crop border. No readable apparatus label, numerical value, scale, coordinate, directed arrow, flag or national symbol appears in the crop. Exact dimensions and identities of individual pieces are not recoverable from these pixels.
